description: This PHP script handles the server-side processing for saving a mail merge operation in SuiteCRM, including retrieving modules, preparing data, executing the merge, and redirecting to a confirmation page.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: Class responsible for performing mail merge operations, including setting data, templates, executing, and cleanup.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Sets the list of data items for the mail merge.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to include in the merge.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Defines the template files for the merge process.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge and returns the output file.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up temporary files created during the merge.
